methodology: Versioned decisions on watcher alerts. Public entries describe a real issuer, venue, protocol or source change. Non-public entries are collection false alarms or transient availability failures and are used only to keep them out of the public product.

items.title: PreStocks doubled its on-chain transfer fee
items.summary: All eight PreStocks mints changed from 50 bps to 100 bps at fee epoch 1039. The maximum fee remains u64::MAX and the shared Squads-controlled address remains both transfer-fee configuration authority and withheld-fee withdrawal authority.
items.whyItMatters: Every transfer now withholds 1%, including wallet-to-wallet transfers and protocol movements. That directly affects exits, collateral transfers and liquidation proceeds.
affectedHolders: all holders and transferees of the eight affected tokens
protocol depositors, borrowers and liquidators moving those tokens

items.title: Ondo moved its ITN integration documentation
items.summary: The old Ondo Stocks path now returns 404. The same issuer documentation is available at the API Reference path, and the dossier now cites that current location.
items.whyItMatters: The authorized-participant in-kind redemption channel remains documented; this was a URL move, not evidence that the channel ended.
affectedHolders: authorized participants using the in-kind redemption channel
holders relying on that channel as an indirect exit route

items.title: Ondo removed its disclosures index; the cited Sales Terms remain available
items.summary: The former disclosures page returns 404. RWA Sonar now cites the issuer-hosted Sales Terms PDF directly, including the Swiss-law cancellation clause used in the legal analysis.
items.whyItMatters: The governing evidence remains readable, but the loss of the index makes document discovery and precedence less transparent.
affectedHolders: Ondo Global Markets holders relying on the Sales Terms
prospective holders comparing document authority and precedence

items.title: Shift removed its markets page
items.summary: The former /markets page returns 404 and is absent from Shift's current sitemap. The SPCX1L product previously listed there could not be found on-chain.
items.whyItMatters: A product name without a current issuer page or an exact mint cannot be treated as an available tokenized asset.
affectedHolders: people evaluating the advertised SPCX1L product
current holders only if an exact token address is later established
items.after: Page removed; exact mint still unverified

items.title: Remora's token-metadata bucket disappeared
items.summary: The S3 bucket referenced by the rToken mints now returns NoSuchBucket. On-chain names and symbols remain, but wallets can no longer retrieve the issuer-hosted logo and description.
items.whyItMatters: The programme has already wound down; loss of issuer-hosted metadata is another observable degradation while residual tokens and holders remain on-chain.
affectedHolders: wallet users relying on issuer-hosted names, logos and descriptions

sources.label: TSLAr metadata URI written into the mint

items.title: The xStocks launch release moved to PR Newswire's canonical page
items.summary: The tools.prnewswire.com live-event URL returns 404, while PR Newswire's canonical release remains available with the original Backed Finance launch announcement.
items.whyItMatters: The launch and initial DeFi-integration claims remain readable; only the transient event URL disappeared.
affectedHolders: people verifying historical xStocks launch and integration claims

sources.label: Backed's xStocks Go Live Today on Bybit, Kraken, and Solana DeFi

items.title: Remora's proof-of-reserves page disappeared with the programme
items.summary: The Remora Markets domain no longer resolves, including its proof-of-reserves page. This follows the programme's February 2026 wind-down; residual token supply remains an on-chain fact, but the live reserve disclosure is no longer available.
items.whyItMatters: A residual holder can no longer verify backing through the issuer's former live disclosure, so historical claims must be read as historical rather than current reserve evidence.
affectedHolders: people assessing whether historical backing claims remain current

sources.label: Solana Compass programme history and wind-down record

items.note: Four same-day diffs changed embedded live prices, market tables and sidebar ordering. The article's comparison, ownership and redemption prose did not change; this is dynamic-page noise, not an actor changing a token or its terms.
The diffs were confined to the publisher's rotating product and forum lists outside the cited article. No Republic Mirror product term changed.
The article body and its custody, ownership, redemption and deadline claims did not change. Only embedded live token prices changed.
The cited Remora KYB announcement remained unchanged. The diff was entirely the publisher's rotating Related stories list, whose unrelated story contained the keyword lockup.
Four CoinDesk diffs changed only live market tickers, relative story ages and sidebar ordering. The cited articles' tokenization, wind-down, listing and invalid-transfer reporting did not change.
The comparison's legal and product prose remained unchanged. Only two embedded live prices changed.

These events came from initial machine-verification wording that did not exactly match the current official page, or from a verifier-normalization false negative. Current dossier claims now quote the official source exactly. This is RWA Sonar research maintenance, not an external change in holder rights.
The SECZ article body remained unchanged. The diff only reordered CryptoTimes' Latest News and related-story shelf; it did not alter Securitize, token or protocol facts.
